subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: Should backup startup automatically delete old OpenClaw-owned temp artifacts after the grace window once the matcher covers timestamped outputs?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but deleting stale partial backup artifacts is a compatibility and availability policy choice because operators may inspect those artifacts and concurrent backup safety depends on the owner guard.

options.title: Repair and accept guarded cleanup
options.body: Broaden matching for timestamped backup temps, keep the one-hour and live-owner guards, and accept automatic cleanup as the intended recovery path.

options.title: Keep fixed-output cleanup only
options.body: Accept that the PR only handles stable explicit output filenames and leave default or directory-output timestamped archive temps for separate follow-up.

options.title: Pause for a different recovery policy
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers choose a non-destructive or more observable recovery/debugging policy for stale backup artifacts.

recommendation.title: Repair and accept guarded cleanup
recommendation.body: Broaden matching for timestamped backup temps, keep the one-hour and live-owner guards, and accept automatic cleanup as the intended recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original backup CLI PR and authored the extraction into the current backup-create infra surface.
